concept.role: Coordinated concept reference for all six separate paintings.
concept.prompt: Create an original coordinated set of SIX exquisite hand-painted Catholic devotional vignette illustrations for a refined Brazilian prayer app called O Jardim de Maria. Output ONE portrait PNG art atlas on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background, arranged in a precise 2-column by 3-row grid of SIX EQUAL SQUARE cells (ideal total canvas 1024x1536). Each illustration must be fully contained in its cell, centered with at least 12% transparent breathing margin. No marks between cells. No text, lettering, labels, numbers, borders, panels, graphic symbols, watermarks, or fake checkerboard. All background outside the actual painted objects is alpha transparent, including between leaves and around halos. Style: beautiful classical sacred realism inspired by early Renaissance Madonnas and warm Murillo light, but soft delicate gouache and watercolor brushwork, natural materials, tender human faces, restrained antique gold, sage green, cream linen, dusty blush and Marian blue. Elegant original paintings, never flat vector icons, never cartoons, never plastic 3D. Subtle cast shadows only immediately under objects; no rectangular backdrop. The six specific independent compositions, by exact grid position: TOP LEFT (morning): a delicate worn stone garden window arch holding a tiny bronze morning bell, a small clear glass vase with one white lily and sage leaves, first amber dawn light touching the stone, an airy hopeful silhouette. TOP RIGHT (night): a lovingly detailed lit antique olive-oil lamp beside a closed midnight-blue prayer book and a sprig of white jasmine, a small subtle crescent moon above, calm deep blue and warm candlelight, no dark rectangular background. MIDDLE LEFT (consolation): a waist-up dignified adult Jesus the Good Shepherd with a gentle realistic bearded face, shoulder-length chestnut hair, ivory robe and soft sage mantle, thin gold halo, cradling exactly ONE small white lamb tenderly; anatomically correct hands, natural face, quiet compassion, not a cartoon. MIDDLE RIGHT (thanksgiving): a low woven harvest basket containing a small rustic loaf, figs, one pomegranate, purple grapes, two golden wheat stems, a pale linen napkin and a few olive leaves; warm grateful abundance, modest not lavish. BOTTOM LEFT (communion): exactly ONE small noble antique gold Eucharistic chalice with a single round plain ivory host suspended just above it, folded white altar linen, two ears of wheat and a few grapes, a gentle sacred light around the host; no letters on host, no blood. BOTTOM RIGHT (Marian prayer): a waist-up serene young Virgin Mary, natural realistic face and delicate hands, ivory dress and muted Marian blue mantle, thin gold halo, reading a small OPEN antique prayer book with entirely blank cream pages, one rosebud and white lily at her side. Mary is alone, no child. Each cell has equally careful detail, coherent painterly scale and colors, crisp enough to read at 64dp. Keep all six compositions visually distinct and all silhouettes complete. This is original production artwork, not a screenshot or UI mockup.

entrance.prompt: Create ONE original beautiful wide hand-painted Catholic devotional illustration for the entrance of an offline prayer library in the app O Jardim de Maria. Landscape composition, approximately 3:2, isolated on TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY with generous clear margins around every object. A quiet small garden chapel seen through an elegant weathered cream-stone arch: a half-open carved wooden door, a little wooden reading stand with an open antique book whose pages have no writing at all, a simple fine antique-gold rosary draped naturally from the stand with one small cross, a modest bronze oil lamp, one white lily in a small pale terracotta vase, and blush climbing roses with sage foliage embracing one side of the arch. Beyond the door, a hint of softly illuminated garden path and a tiny stone fountain, integrated as a softly painted vignette that dissolves gracefully to full transparency, no rectangle and no opaque white sky. Warm morning light, hushed inviting atmosphere, exquisite natural texture, refined old-world sacred watercolor and gouache realism inspired by Renaissance painting and Murillo's warm light. Harmonize warm ivory, dusty blush rose, sage green, subdued Marian blue, and restrained old gold. Distinct architectural silhouette and lovely hand-painted details. No people, no text, no letter-like marks, no banners, no labels, no UI, no watermark, no fake checkerboard background. All rosary beads and cross remain subtle and anatomically plausible objects; keep the composition calm and not crowded. All artwork must fit inside the canvas with at least 10% transparent margin, suitable for a welcoming 280dp by 160dp illustration on both cream and dark forest backgrounds. A finished unique production painting, not a generic stock icon.
